summary: Crews were sent to a vehicle fire near a fire station. The burned truck was left on the roadway, and casino security held traffic back until a tow could reach it. CHP asked whether the owner, a casino employee, was on scene.
Crews were sent to a medical aid on Lerdo Highway for a pedestrian reported down just west of Quality Road.
CHP worked a two-vehicle collision with a complaint of pain; the drivers exchanged information.

disposition: caller advised by her mother to call law enforcement
summary: A woman asked deputies to a parking lot where she said her boyfriend had battered her, and that he was armed in the lot.

disposition: rescue response; witness on scene; no injuries reported
summary: Multiple cars ended up off the roadway at Calloway Drive, drawing a rescue response. A witness on scene reported no injuries.
Officers issued a be-on-the-lookout for a juvenile reported missing after being dropped off at a junior high school earlier in the evening.
A caller asked deputies to check on an elderly couple at a home on Kern Canyon Road.

disposition: lane closed; crash east of the intersection
summary: Water flooded the lanes near White Lane and Gosford Road, closing one lane, and a crash was reported east of the intersection.
Officers were sent to a fight on Feliz Drive reported between a man, his grandfather and a neighbor. The caller said he was injured, and a second caller reported the fight still going in the street.

disposition: officers asked to look for the truck
summary: CHP was asked to watch for a semi with a reefer trailer swerving eastbound on Highway 46 from Brown Material Road.
A squad was sent to a medical aid on Marie Avenue for traumatic injuries.
Officers were sent to an alley behind a market on East California Avenue.
Crews were sent to the front of a business on Buck Owens Boulevard for an unknown medical aid.

disposition: caller reported a gun; officers sent
summary: Officers were sent to a Family Dollar on Highway 58 after a caller reported a man on a scooter with a black backpack and a handgun, who then left toward the highway.
A caller reported hearing about six gunshots over five minutes near 10th Street and Lincoln Street. Officers were sent to check the area.
A commercial fire alarm brought a crew to a business on Willis Avenue.
Deputies were sent to a report of a bonfire and underage drinking off Tehachapi-Willow Springs Road.

disposition: caller hung up; no answer on callbacks
summary: A caller reported an intruder at a home on Troy Street near Eucalyptus Drive, then hung up and did not answer return calls.
Officers stopped a wrong-way driver near 23rd Street and Lincoln Street, in the parking lot of an audio shop.

disposition: four juveniles with guns reported on foot
summary: Officers were sent to Airport Drive and Washington Avenue after a caller reported four juveniles with firearms walking northbound toward Woodrow Avenue.

disposition: fire extinguished; utility asked to respond
summary: Crews put out an electrical fire inside a sub-panel and asked the utility to help secure the building, because on-site security could not shut the power down.
Officers were sent to Rosedale Highway after a woman reported being chased by a man in a red sedan.
Officers were sent to a large party where a physical fight was reported. A caller then reported hearing a single gunshot, and a man at the scene was reported to have a silver long gun.
Officers were sent to a home on Gosford Road for a domestic fight.
Deputies asked for a police dog as they went to a disturbance at a home where a man was in a room with a 4-year-old and a 5-year-old, and the family was inside the residence.
Two SUVs collided at a Taco Bell on East California Avenue at Oak Street. An ambulance was sent, and a large group gathered in the drive-thru.
A crew was sent to a person found unresponsive at an RV park on South Edison Road.
A man was reported sitting on a doorstep refusing to leave and possibly intoxicated, and officers were sent.

disposition: two vehicles off the roadway; one yellow tag; response upgraded
summary: A two-vehicle head-on crash north of Sycamore Road left both vehicles off the roadway with major front-end damage. One person was a yellow tag and Engine 46, Engine 48 and Battalion 4 responded, with the call upgraded to a heavier response.

disposition: in progress; child on the floor
summary: Deputies were sent to a motel in Maricopa where a family was reported to be looking for someone to beat up their daughter; the girl was reported down on the floor and deputies were still trying to work out whether she was conscious.

disposition: air unit overhead; victim brought out
summary: Deputies were sent to a home on Southland Court where several people in dark clothing were reported hiding near a trailer park entrance and a man inside was reported to have a large kitchen knife. The air unit flew over the search and a victim was brought out of the house.
Officers were sent to a large party at a new construction site, where a loud argument was also reported at the back of the property.
Officers were sent to a report of multiple gunshots fired in the 7500 block of a residential street. A unit that had been in the area reported hearing no gunfire.

disposition: subject ran on foot; scene cleared
summary: Officers followed a lifted SUV in the Gosford Road area after a report of a possibly armed man, and a subject ran on foot across the street from the vehicle. The search ended with the scene clear.
Crews were sent to a vehicle rollover on the eastbound side of the highway just west of Coffee Road.

Officers and fire crews were sent to a report of a shooting on Martin Avenue. One person was reported hit, crews were held back while officers worked the scene, and an air ambulance was asked to stand by.
Security at a business reported a large fight involving about 10 people and weapons.
A single vehicle went off Lerdo Highway west of Wasco and one person was reported possibly ejected. Crews from Station 32 responded and an ambulance was asked to stand by.

disposition: three patients; one trapped; air ambulance stood down
summary: A head-on crash on Highway 46 east of Curt Road hurt three people. One was trapped in a vehicle and tagged red, a second was tagged yellow, and a third was also worked on; Mercy Air was launched and Highway 46 was shut down for a landing zone, but fog turned the helicopter back to base. Both lanes were left blocked with debris and a car.
A crew checked a report of smoke at a home on Linda Vista Drive.
Officers were sent to a domestic call on Harless Street where a woman said her boyfriend rammed her vehicle with his car.
Officers were sent to a traffic collision on Reno Avenue.
Officers were sent to a domestic call on Augusta Street where a man was reported to be trying to force the caller into a vehicle.

disposition: traffic officers requested; two people arguing on scene
summary: A white hatchback hit a pedestrian on East 7th Street. Two people were reported arguing at the scene and traffic officers were requested.
A crew was sent to a residential fire alarm on Parkgate Street.

disposition: drive-by; one person with major injuries; suspect vehicle fled
summary: A drive-by shooting in the 500 block of East Belle Terrace left one person with major injuries. The suspect vehicle, a black four-door, was last seen northbound on South Real Road toward Stockdale Highway.

disposition: one person held at gunpoint; fire crews also sent
summary: Officers and fire crews were sent to a report of one person held at gunpoint.

disposition: caller reported firearms and bats; officers sent
summary: A fight at Flower Street and Alta Vista Drive escalated until a caller reported about 30 people there with firearms and bats. Officers were sent.
A caller told dispatchers that juveniles were trying to start something at his home and that he would shoot them if no one was sent.
A caller on American Avenue told dispatchers there were intruders at his address, and officers made contact with him.
Officers were sent to an audible alarm on Brooklyn Avenue.
Person suffers cardiac arrest near Lakeland Street.
Person injured in accident near Guildford Street, Bakersfield.
Person having difficulty walking after vehicle incident on CA-46.
Verbal dispute involving person in black Honda.
Vehicle off roadway on Martin Avenue, no injuries.
Man assaulted with rock on R Street in Bakersfield.
Vehicle rollover on Highway 119 near Highway 43.
Single vehicle off roadway on Martin Avenue.
